text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with marginal overnight gains, suggesting cautious consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. Extreme fear sentiment (13/100) and rising Bitcoin dominance (57.8%) indicate traders are rotating into perceived safety, though the $85B daily volume is subdued relative to recent volatility, implying limited appetite to commit capital at current levels. Smaller caps like SOL are outpacing the majors, a typical pattern when risk-off sentiment begins to ease, but the overall tone remains defensive.
